features.text: STATIC/FLEX THERAPY SYSTEM: Delivers gentle, prolonged stretch therapy to reduce contractures and improve range of motion.
ADAPTIVE FLEX RESPONSE: Accommodates spasticity and tone changes for consistent, safe stretching.
INTEGRATED GONIOMETER: Provides visual angle reference for precise therapy adjustments.
AXIAL HINGE SUPPORT: Aligns naturally with the joint to minimize stress during movement or therapy.
COMFORTABLE FIT: Padded cuffs and adjustable straps provide long-term comfort and secure positioning.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
